entries.title: Floating Paintbrushes Painting in Midair
entries.description: Several floating paintbrush objects sweep through a light 3D space, leaving semi-transparent colored stroke ribbons that curve, intersect, fade over time, and gently collide with invisible walls that bend their paths.

entries.title: Robotic Arms Painting a 3D Canvas
